source: Moonbot Side-Scroller Update - Sprite Bible V2

production_focus.summary: Bigger Moonbot, more movement, mobile-first readability, prop-heavy action flows, and funny side-scroller chaos without player-controlled platforming.
production_focus.stage_usage: Moonbot should travel across the bounded side-view lane during action flows.

base_character.name: MOONBOT PET VISOR V1
base_character.description: Glossy white Moonbot robot companion with large rounded helmet/head, small rounded bot body, mitten hands, chunky robot feet, black glass visor, and pink LED eyes.

terminology_rules.negative_prompt: No tail, no ears, no snout, no animal body, no fur, no paws, no whiskers, no claws.

production_rules: All gameplay animations must be side-view compatible.
Use autonomous left/right sprite logic and mirroring where practical.
User input is care/action buttons, not direct movement controls.
Do not add keyboard platformer controls, collision gameplay, manual jumping, or combat control loops.
Do not expand the isometric/down-facing pipeline for current gameplay.
Old isometric assets remain archived reference only.
Character sprite sheets should use transparent backgrounds where possible.
Keep frame count, frame size, sheet size, ground line, and silhouette consistent.
Make Moonbot large enough for mobile/Telegram readability.
Use props to drive action staging, comedy, and clear care/action feedback.

gameplay_model.title: Autonomous Pet, Not Player-Controlled Platformer
gameplay_model.description: Moonpet remains an autonomous virtual pet game in a side-view room or rooftop stage. User care/action buttons trigger scripted Moonbot behaviours; Moonbot may walk, run, jump, eat, sleep, play, clean, or train inside the viewport and then return to idle.
action_flow_examples: Eat button: Moonbot walks to snack or bowl, eats, returns to idle.
Play button: Moonbot runs or bounces toward a toy, plays, returns to idle.
Clean button: Moonbot moves to a cleaning spot, plays bubbles or polish animation, returns to idle.
Sleep button: Moonbot walks to a sleep spot, lies down, sleeps.
Train button: Moonbot walks to a training spot and performs a non-combat train animation.

animation_states.label: Idle
animation_states.description: Calm side-view idle with subtle breathing or bounce.

animation_states.label: Run
animation_states.description: Fast side-view run with clear stride and motion.

animation_states.label: Jump
animation_states.description: Side-view jump with simple squash/stretch and clean landing.

animation_states.label: Sleep
animation_states.description: Side-view sleeping pose with gentle breathing.

side_eat: interact with snack or oversized food prop
side_play: play with beach ball or toy prop
side_clean: bubbles and sponge or soap motion

environments.description: Cozy side-view safe house or Moonbot room.
Small ramen or snack stop for food interactions.
Neon rooftop training area with dumbbell or punch bag props.
Side-view rest spot with bed, pillow, and music props.
Horizontal neon city lane for future autonomous exploration.
